candidates.decision_relevance: Would let the reviews test whether declines, rebounds, and relative weakness occurred before or after each freeze, rather than infer path and warning timing from weekly endpoints.
candidates.evidence_reference: W44 review: no numerical price path or freeze-time warning sequence; W43/W42 reviews: exact price paths and time-ordered signal observations are absent. Daily reviews also flag incomplete short-horizon sequences and cutoff alignment.
candidates.metric_name: BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC hourly price series with observation timestamps
candidates.missing_history_problem: Weekly returns and selected horizon summaries do not reveal the intervening path or establish which observations were available at each decision cutoff.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would help determine whether participation deterioration or recovery persisted and how it sequenced with price moves, while making snapshot changes easier to interpret.
candidates.evidence_reference: W44 review: no W44 breadth series; W37 reviews: breadth methodology, timestamps, and sequence are missing. Daily reviews repeatedly describe top-100 breadth snapshots with changing membership hashes and no comparable continuous series.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped advancer/decliner counts and constituent membership for the reported breadth universe
candidates.missing_history_problem: Point-in-time proxy snapshots with changing membership cannot establish persistence, comparability, or whether breadth changes preceded price weakness.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether reported inflows or outflows were persistent or divergent across sessions, improving assessment of the flow evidence alongside price and participation.
candidates.evidence_reference: W44 review: latest supplied settled-flow detail is W43, not W44. Multiple daily reviews state that ETF evidence covers only one settled session and cannot establish a persistent flow trend.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF net flows in source-reported units
candidates.missing_history_problem: Single-session rows and gaps between weekly summaries do not establish the direction, duration, or sequencing of settled flows.
